description: A newsletter published by the Weavers Guild of Minnesota for January 1991 containing descriptions of upcoming members meetings, study group meetings, and workshops; notes from the president and from the yarn committee; a financial report from Fiber Fair; a recipe for Cottage Herb Loaf; a call for volunteers for open committee chair positions; the article "Spinning Yarns"; and a calendar of January classes.
